## Research target

Describe the code, data, format, asset, script, or subsystem to investigate.

## Version / revision

List the relevant game version, region, language, revision, build, or executable when known.

## Known evidence

Include offsets, symbols, hashes, file names, identifiers, screenshots, logs, or related references.

## Questions to answer

- [ ] Structure or behavior identified
- [ ] Version differences checked where relevant
- [ ] Findings reproduced or independently verified
- [ ] Documentation updated

## Notes

Clearly distinguish confirmed observations from hypotheses.
